summary: End of the 前言 (p9), the full table of contents (p10-15), and the Part 1 技术篇 divider page (p16). The 前言 conclusion stresses studying historical charts to recognise the main force's phases (accumulation / markup / distribution), starting live trading with small capital, and above all decisive execution of stops; it also states chart conventions (dividend-adjusted 填权息 charts, unrestricted tradability assumption, custom 4-colour K-line software). The TOC defines the book's 12 techniques (W底, 破底翻, 破底翻W底, 下飘旗形, 上飘旗形, M头, 假突破, 头肩顶, 假突破头肩顶, 头肩底, 收敛三角形头部, 收敛三角形底部) plus a 时间波 appendix, Part 2 进阶篇 (Taiwan index and individual stocks), appendices and afterword.

rules.rule: Study historical charts: the main force's accumulation, markup and distribution always leave traces in pattern and volume-price structure; study them per period, ideally together with contemporaneous events.
rules.quote_zh: 这是历史演进的活教材，主力盘底进货、拉抬作价、盘头出货凡走过必留下痕迹。

rules.rule: Main-force cycle has three phases and corresponding actions: accumulation period (buy), markup period (add early, then ride/坐轿), distribution period (sell, or even flip to short).
rules.quote_zh: 进货期（买进）、拉抬期（初期加码后坐轿）、出货期（卖出甚至翻空操作）

rules.rule: After some study, begin with a small amount of capital to accumulate live experience.
rules.quote_zh: 建议一段时间的学习稍有把握后，开始以少量资金作实务上的操作累积经验

rules.rule: Setting the stop precisely matters, but executing it strictly and decisively (严格果断) is a separate, harder requirement.
rules.quote_zh: 精确的设定停损固然重要，但是能够“严格果断”执行停损又是一回事。

rules.rule: After a first successful swing with an aggressively deployed plan, keep refining the same model; do not let one hesitation destroy long-term effort. Strict stops are the foundation of long-term success; money management and swing trading are its expression.
rules.quote_zh: 严设停损是长期成功的根本，资金控管及波段操作则是成功的体现。

rules.rule: Chart convention: all individual-stock charts in the book are dividend/rights-adjusted (填权息图), so pattern price levels refer to adjusted prices.
rules.quote_zh: 本书的个股技术分析图均为填权息图。

rules.rule: Analysis assumes any instrument can be traded without restriction (e.g. no margin/short-sale restrictions or forced short covering 融券强迫回补).
rules.quote_zh: 本技术分析皆假设任何商品可以交易，且不受任何影响的情况下（如无信用交易或融券强迫回补等）。

rules.rule: The book uses a self-made 4-colour K-line software; volume-price structure and patterns are identical to standard charts, so candle colours can be ignored.
rules.quote_zh: 本书使用的是自创的4色K线软件，但量价结构与型态完全相同，没有影响，读者不必在意颜色的不同。

rules.rule: Book taxonomy (TOC): long signals = W底涨幅满足, 破底翻, 破底翻(W底), 下飘旗形 波段涨幅满足, 头肩底涨幅满足, 收敛三角形底部涨幅满足; short signals = 上飘旗形 波段跌幅满足, M头跌幅满足, 假突破, 头肩顶跌幅满足, 假突破(头肩顶), 收敛三角形头部跌幅满足; plus 附注: 时间波 (time waves).
rules.quote_zh: 一、W底涨幅满足计算：多头买进信号 …… 十二、收敛三角形底部涨幅满足计算：多头买进信号

quantifiable: Use dividend/rights-adjusted (forward-adjusted) OHLCV for all pattern levels to match the book's 填权息 charts (p9).
Map each of the 12 TOC patterns to direction: long = {W底, 破底翻, 破底翻W底, 下飘旗形, 头肩底, 收敛三角形底部}; short = {上飘旗形, M头, 假突破, 头肩顶, 假突破头肩顶, 收敛三角形头部} (p10-12).
Every pattern section is framed as a 涨幅满足/跌幅满足 (measured-move target) calculation, so each detector should output a target price, not just a signal (p10-12).
Volume-price divergence near a top (price new high, volume lower than during the 价涨量增 advance) is a warning flag (p16 annotation; rule detail must come from later units).
ambiguities: The p16 divider chart is an unlabelled excerpt; the instrument is not shown. 109 and 112.00 appear near an upward-sloping line, but whether 109 is a neckline value or a target cannot be confirmed from this page. (Inference only: a 1997 daily chart could be one of the Part 2 1997 examples, e.g. 华泰 1997-1998 日线 p158, but this is unverified.)
TOC page numbers are the book's printed page numbers, not PDF page numbers; the offset must be determined from the body units.
'坐轿' (ride the sedan) in the markup phase implies holding without adding further, but holding/adding rules are not specified here.
Assumption of unrestricted tradability (p9) means short signals in the book ignore real-world borrow constraints.
